Name: Object Product Display
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod causes objects producing items to show the item being produced in front of the object (optionally only while holding down a mod key).

By default, the item will be initially shown as a silhouette and gradually fill in as the object is produced. This only works for objects where production was begun by the player with the mod installed, since the game does not normally keep a record of when production began or total production time required.

For items that haven't registered a beginning production time, or if you turn off [b]ShowProgress[/b] in the config, the mod will by default show a looping animation going from a silhouette to the full color icon. You can have the mod show just the full color icon by turning off [b]ShowProgressing[/b] in the config.
